# Feature Specification: Em-Dash Phase Headers Fixture

**Feature Branch**: `006-emdash-phases`

**Created**: 2026-06-07

**Status**: Draft

## Overview

A spec whose `tasks.md` uses em-dash phase-header delimiters instead
of the canonical colon form. The strict colon-only parser matches
NONE of these headings, so zero task-phase sub-issues are created.
Used to verify the near-miss WARNING makes that otherwise silent miss
loud, while NOT broadening the accepted grammar.
